name: unpaged
description: Renders Claude Code and GitHub Copilot plans as whiteboards on Unpaged and attaches a Can view invite link and preview to the branch's pull request. /unpaged:visual-plan turns the plan in your conversation into a canvas of phases, tasks, and dependencies and listens to its @agent comments (delivered automatically inside Claude Code or GitHub Copilot; in Claude Code a line above the prompt shows what you listen to, and on older Claude Code builds a background Monitor polls instead); approving the plan stamps the canvas EXECUTING. While the plan is implemented the session keeps a Decision log on the canvas; /unpaged:as-built then compiles the as-built record — what shipped vs the plan, every decision and its why, the data flow, a reviewer's guide — as a frozen canvas nested under the plan and refreshes the pull request preview. Every plan is filed in the Visual plans folder of your Unpaged library. /unpaged:architecture draws the repository's architecture document from its code and compares it with the code when you ask (a compare button on the line above the prompt in Claude Code, /unpaged:architecture compare anywhere; verdicts logged in GitHub Copilot), with update to rewrite what no longer holds.
